# payloads

A table. Raw vendor responses, a purgeable cache tier (ADR-030) — never facts.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | PRIMARY KEY |
| `identity_id` | TEXT | NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id) |
| `adapter` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `run_id` | TEXT |  |
| `content_type` | TEXT |  |
| `body` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `expires_at` | TEXT |  |

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE TABLE payloads (
  id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- ULID
  identity_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
  adapter      TEXT NOT NULL,             -- adapter id that fetched it
  run_id       TEXT,
  content_type TEXT,                      -- e.g. application/json, text/markdown
  body         TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at   TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX ix_payloads_lookup ON payloads(identity_id, adapter, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_payloads_expiry ON payloads(expires_at);
```
